title: Wie Fenzi lückenlose Regelkonformität gewährleistet

title: AGC: Transluzente Flächen für Architektur und Innenausbau
summary: AGC's Matelux glass combines high light transmission with effective privacy, expanding its application from traditional interiors to translucent facades. summary: The Schaeffler AG has developed a transparent interior concept for its new project and technology center in Bühl, featuring flexible system glass walls over 15,000 m². Incorporating wood and glass, the architecture promotes an open, adaptable work environment that meets modern mobility challenges.

title: Frerichs Glas: 44 neue Ornament- und Dekorgläser im Programm
summary: Frerichs Glas expands its design collection with 44 new ornamental and decorative glasses, offering diverse options for architects and designers. summary: Inotherm is a leading Slovenian manufacturer of aluminum front doors, known for quality and innovative design. summary: Deceuninck introduces a new door concept using Frager's patented Magnetude technology, which eliminates the need for adhesives and minimizes installation issues. summary: Warema prioritizes comprehensive testing for snow loads and rainfall to ensure robust outdoor solutions. summary: The article discusses the renovation of the La Quercetta estate, emphasizing the integration of KE solutions to harmonize functionality and aesthetics in outdoor spaces. summary: Despite being banned for nearly thirty years due to its health risks, asbestos still persists in residential areas, according to a recent report by the General Directorate of Health. summary: A collective led by the Île-de-France architects' council demands a reaffirmation of quality in public procurement processes. summary: The article discusses the potential slowdown in public procurement due to rising prices, highlighting challenges faced by the sector. summary: L'association Commande architecture publique privée Grand-Est (Capp-GE) vise à améliorer la qualité des commandes publiques en accompagnant les maîtres d'œuvre. title: Dans la distribution de matériaux, l'éco-conception pousse ses pions sur le lot revêtements de sols
summary: Le secteur de la construction intensifie ses efforts pour réduire les émissions de carbone, y compris dans des domaines souvent négligés, comme les revêtements de sols. title: Nouvelle transformation en vue pour le Cnit de La Défense
summary: Le CNIT de la Défense va subir une transformation majeure pour moderniser son espace. summary: La Banque des territoires, représentant de la Caisse des dépôts, annonce la mobilisation de 5 milliards d'euros pour soutenir des projets énergétiques. summary: Gauthier Louette, the historical CEO of Spie, announced his transition on March 6, 2026, during a press conference in Paris. summary: For the Milan Design Week, architect Lina Ghotmeh unveiled an ephemeral pink maze titled 'Metamorphosis in Motion'. summary: The article discusses notable construction and renovation projects currently underway across various cities in France. summary: The Celtic Interconnector project continues to advance as France and Ireland work on establishing a new electricity highway. summary: David PALMERO, director at MALERBA, discusses the need for motorized D.A.S door blocks that address safety, accessibility, and access control amid growing demands for hygienic, automated solutions post-COVID. summary: Bouygues is set to significantly increase its recruitment efforts in 2026, aiming to position itself as the third-largest private employer in France. summary: Le Fort Boyard, en service depuis 169 ans, souffre de l'érosion et a subi vingt-cinq interventions pour des fissures. summary: Vincent Jeanbrun, the Minister for Housing, announced plans to host the Property Diagnostic Assizes on May 21, 2026, in collaboration with Deputy Daniel Labaronne. summary: The annual competition 'Le Meilleur Chantier de France' allows ESTP students to evaluate top construction sites across various criteria, highlighting innovations and environmental approaches in the construction sector. summary: In Lille, the new Saint-Sauveur multipurpose gymnasium features impressive wooden arches that evoke the industrial heritage of the site. summary: In the Czech municipality of Prosecnice, Studio Mimosa Architects has created a wooden house nestled within a forest along the Sázava River. summary: L'activité des TPE montre une amélioration au premier trimestre 2026, cependant, le secteur de la construction reste en retrait. Malgré des signes positifs dans d'autres domaines, la construction peine à progresser. Cela soulève des préoccupations concernant la dynamique du marché.

summary: La préfète du Rhône a rétabli le droit pour six maires de délivrer des permis de construire, suite à des avancées dans la création de logements sociaux. This strategic move aims to accelerate the development of trusted data ecosystems and artificial intelligence. The partnership is expected to enhance collaborative solutions in data management.

title: L'Auxiliaire reelects its president
summary: Thibault Richard continues to lead L'Auxiliaire, with significant developments in the organization. The article discusses his ongoing presidency and the impacts on the auxiliary sector. Further insights are likely behind a paywall, revealing important industry trends.

title: Ingérop strengthens its presence in Switzerland
summary: Ingérop has strengthened its presence in Romandy, Switzerland, by acquiring the Pierre Chuard group. This acquisition enhances Ingérop's expertise in climate engineering, fluid management, and energy efficiency of buildings. The move consolidates its regional foothold.

title: In Tours, a school completely redesigned to withstand heatwaves
summary: The city of Tours proudly inaugurated the newly rebuilt Claude-Bernard school on June 19, 2026, as a key component of the national urban renewal program (NPNRU) benefiting the Sanitas district. This event highlights the city's commitment to improving local infrastructure and education facilities. The new school is set to enhance the educational environment for the community.

title: Several institutions unite to help schools face extreme heat
summary: Face à la canicule, plusieurs institutions ont débloqué un budget d'urgence de 130 millions d'euros pour améliorer les conditions des salles de classe. Ces mesures visent à lutter contre la chaleur intense que subissent les élèves dans les écoles. Les investissements devraient permettre d'équiper les classes afin de rendre l'apprentissage plus confortable.

title: Housing recovery: the countdown to pass the bill has begun
summary: The French government is accelerating the examination of the housing revival bill, originally presented on June 24. It will be discussed by the Senate on July 7, addressing a critical housing crisis. This legislative move aims to decentralize housing initiatives amid increasing demand.

title: A new director at the Toulouse School of Architecture
summary: Mahmoud Ismaïl has been appointed as the new director of the École nationale supérieure d'architecture (Ensa) in Toulouse, starting July 15, 2026. He is set to hold this position for a three-year term. This change marks a significant transition for the institution.

title: Innovative solutions and significant technical means to renovate the main runway of Basel-Mulhouse airport in just one month
summary: La rénovation de la piste principale de l’aéroport Bâle-Mulhouse a été accomplie en un mois, avec des solutions innovantes et des moyens techniques considérables. 1,5 km de cette piste et 2,1 km de taxiway ont été réhabilités, surpassant le délai prévu grâce à une préparation minutieuse et une application de béton rapide. Ce projet, réussi avec un coût de 40 millions d'euros, a permis d'améliorer également la drai-nabilité de la piste.

title: Theater Renovations in Nantes, Nanterre, and Saint-Cloud Transform Performance Spaces into Community Venues
summary: Les théâtres Amandiers, 3 Pierrots et Espace 44 ont récemment été rénovés pour devenir des espaces de vie ouverts à tous, transformant la manière dont le public interagit avec ces lieux. En améliorant leur accueil, ils visent à attirer de nouveaux visiteurs, notamment avec des espaces de restauration accessibles à tous. Ces projets illustrent une volonté de moderniser l'offre culturelle et de renforcer le lien avec la communauté.

title: Bordeaux's Future Reuse Center Offers a New Approach to Waste Management in Dense Urban Areas
summary: Le centre de réemploi Monséjour à Bordeaux vise à transformer la gestion des déchets en milieu urbain dense grâce à une approche d'économie circulaire. Le projet, mené par Bordeaux Métropole et SRIA, inclut une boutique au rez-de-chaussée et des bureaux pour des entreprises de l'économie sociale à l'étage. Sa conception bioclimatique et l'utilisation de matériaux réemployés illustrent une démarche durable et respectueuse de l'environnement.

title: Toulouse: Selective Deconstruction in Mirail
summary: A selective deconstruction project is underway for the 260-unit Tripode building in Mirail, Toulouse, originally built in the 1960s. The project, valued at €2.5 million, focuses on achieving a 97% material recovery rate while conducting asbestos removal. Following the deconstruction, Bouygues Immobilier plans to construct 400 new housing units on the site.

title: Southern Bordeaux: Railway Improvements Progressing Well
summary: Les aménagements ferroviaires au sud de Bordeaux avancent rapidement avec 6 km de caténaires et 1,5 km de voies déjà mises en service. Le projet de 1 Md € comprend la création de nouvelles lignes et la transformation des haltes ferroviaires en pôles multimodaux, prévu pour s'achever en 2032. Ce chantier, piloté par SNCF Réseau, vise à améliorer l'accessibilité et la circulation des trains dans la région.

title: In Bouscat, Bouygues Construction's intervention transforms the racecourse area into a new reality
summary: The Bouygues Construction project in Au Bouscat aims to revitalize the Champ de Courses neighborhood by demolishing an existing building and constructing new residential units. This project includes significant renovations, improving living conditions and infrastructure while preserving historical elements. Completion is expected by May 2027, with a total investment of €25 million.

title: Vitrolles: Setec Acquires Custom Regional Headquarters
summary: Setec has inaugurated its new regional headquarters in Vitrolles, constructed over two years at a cost of €18.4 million. The building features eco-friendly designs such as a climatic well and green-tinted ceramic facades, promoting energy efficiency and comfort. It has achieved gold certification for Mediterranean sustainable buildings and is characterized by its distinctive curved shapes.

title: Modernization of Ametyst in Montpellier Enters Consultation Phase
summary: Montpellier's public consultation for the modernization of the Amétyst waste treatment site concluded on June 14, 2026. The project aims to drastically reduce waste exports and significantly increase energy production through biomethane. An investment of €110 million is set for the developments scheduled from late 2027 to 2029.

title: Nice: Metro Validates Tram Line 5
summary: The Nice Côte d’Azur metropolitan area has approved the creation of tram line 5, which will cost an estimated €376 million. This new 7.6 km line will connect key neighborhoods and include 15 stations, multi-modal exchange facilities, and park-and-ride services. The project follows a favorable public investigation and is designed by Ingérop, Egis Rail, and LA/BA Architects.

title: Bouches-du-Rhône: 'The Priority Remains the Upgrading of Heritage' – Interview with Damien Vanoverschelde
summary: Damien Vanoverschelde, director of OPH department 13 Habitat, discusses the dire financial situation of the organization, facing a projected deficit of €20 million by 2025. His plan focuses on upgrading the existing housing stock and aims to construct at least 2,500 new homes over ten years. The strategy emphasizes cost management while prioritizing renovations of 12,000 older units to regain financial stability.

title: Briançon: The Fort of Three Heads to Feature in the Olympic Podium
summary: Le fort des Trois-Têtes, situé à Briançon, sera restauré pour accueillir le Village des athlètes des JO 2030 avant de se transformer en un quartier mixte incluant logements et équipements publics. Le projet, estimé à 67 millions d'euros, doit respecter les normes de conservation des monuments historiques. Les travaux débuteront en 2027, avec une livraison prévue en juin 2029.

title: Auxerre: A New XXL Nursing Home Planned for 2028
summary: Un nouvel Ehpad de 19 248 m² sera construit à Auxerre pour 321 lits, avec un projet prévu pour 2028. Ce nouvel établissement vise à regrouper des résidents actuels dans un cadre plus intime et moderne, réparti en 16 unités autonomes. Le budget total de l'opération s'élève à 55,3 millions d'euros, cofinancé par des organismes régionaux.

title: Real Estate: 'For 35 Years, Every Crisis in the Strasbourg Office Market Has Been Overcome, Let's Be Confident' – Olivier Braun
summary: Olivier Braun from Rive Gauche CBRE asserts that Strasbourg's office market has consistently overcome crises over the past 35 years, highlighting a persistent shortage of new offerings. He emphasizes the need to adapt to changing project timelines and market demands, particularly in coworking and flexible office spaces. Despite challenges, Braun urges confidence in launching new projects to meet market needs.

title: Grand Est: Boosting the Renovation of Condominiums
summary: The Merite project in the Grand Est aims to innovate the economic model for renovating private housing cooperatives. Coordinated by Demathieu Bard Energie, it collaborates with various stakeholders to enhance energy efficiency and reduce costs. Over four years, three pilot sites from the 1960s-70s are expected to improve their energy classification significantly.

title: Jura: Grand Dole Habitat Chooses Design-Build with C3B
summary: Grand Dole Habitat initiates a significant renovation project in Dole, Jura, focusing on energy-efficient construction, raising the rating of 14 buildings from D to B by February 2028. The initiative, led by C3B, involves a €12.7 million investment, enhancing 229 residences through sustainable techniques. Additionally, a former senior living facility will be transformed into an intergenerational residence, offering 35 senior units alongside 22 for students and young professionals.

title: Reims: The Esad Curved in Concrete
summary: The newly constructed Esad building in Reims features a unique, curvilinear design, rising five stories on a compact site of 3,500 m². Built at a cost of €35 million, it aims to serve as a symbol of urban renewal for the Port-Colbert neighborhood. With a total area of 8,000 m², the structure promotes collaborative learning spaces and houses various facilities, enhancing educational organization.

title: By 2031, Cars Will No Longer Have a Place in Arras's Grand Place
summary: D'ici 2031, la Grand'Place d'Arras sera transformée en un espace entièrement piéton, sans parking ni circulation automobile. Le projet, dirigé par l’architecte Bruno Fortier, vise à redonner à la place son statut patrimonial. Un investissement de 21,8 M€ TTC est prévu pour réaménager cette zone centrale.

title: North: AI Enhances Product Sheets
summary: In Nord, the startup OneFiche uses AI to enhance product data sheets for construction materials. Founded by industry veterans, it provides a subscription-based platform to connect material suppliers with construction companies. Currently, it features 550 product sheets and aims for national expansion.

title: Pas-de-Calais: Sergeant Grows
summary: L'entreprise Sergeant, spécialisée dans l'enveloppe du bâtiment à Bully-les-Mines, a vu son chiffre d'affaires annuel passer de 4,2 M€ à 13,5 M€ en trois ans grâce à son directeur général, Michael Hamy. L'entreprise vise désormais 20 M€ de chiffre d'affaires, se concentrant sur l'étanchéité-façade qui représente 60 % de ses gains. Pour soutenir sa croissance, Sergeant vient d'achever un nouveau siège de 3 000 m2 et envisage des expansions en Normandie.

title: Change of Destination for Fresnes-sur-Escaut's Train Station in the North
summary: La gare de Fresnes-sur-Escaut a été réhabilitée et accueille maintenant un estaminet après un projet de 3,4 M€. Ce bâtiment du XIXe siècle conserve ses guichets en bois et a vu l'ajout de deux ailes pour accueillir un musée de la mine. Le site est embelli par un parvis réaménagé par des paysagistes.

title: Liévin: Nauticaa Dives into an Economical and Fun Large Bath
summary: Inaugurated in May 2026, the Nauticaa aquatic center in Liévin is a significant upgrade, featuring 6,200 m² of space and capacity for 1,350 visitors. Despite doubling the pool size, environmental efficiency is maintained with reduced water and energy consumption. The center incorporates sustainable design elements, such as elevated construction to mitigate flood risk and a solar panel-equipped roof.

title: In Le Havre, a Dike Emerges to Provide River Access to Port 2000
summary: A new dyke is emerging in Le Havre to provide enhanced river access to Port 2000, with a planned 100-meter wide channel slated for completion by the end of 2027. The project aims to double river traffic between Le Havre and the Seine axis, utilizing 20,000 m³ of materials daily. Vinci Construction leads the project, with significant dredging work already underway to raise the dyke above sea level.

title: Selection of Projects to Monitor in Your Region: West-Center
summary: This article highlights urban and housing projects in the Ouest-Centre region, focusing on various developments including eco-neighborhoods and urban rehabilitation. Key projects include the construction of new housing, public facilities, and facilities like community centers. The initiatives reflect a commitment to sustainable urban development and enhancing community infrastructure.

title: Eure-et-Loir: Anma Designs Its First 100% Wood School
summary: ANMA's innovative project in Eure-et-Loir showcases a 100% wooden school, designed to host 450 students with a structure of 4,000 m2 and natural ventilation. This eco-friendly building replaces an old social housing block as part of a major urban renewal program. Delays in construction due to fire resistance issues and humidity concerns are expected, with completion set for the end of the year.

title: After Supporting Developers, CDC Habitat Obtains Approval for Social Housing in Brittany and Wants to Develop Student Housing in Rennes
summary: CDC Habitat has received approval to expand its role in social housing in Brittany, aiming to support student housing initiatives in Rennes. The organization plans to manage new social housing projects through its brand, Studefi. This move reflects CDC Habitat's commitment to addressing local housing needs while maintaining fiscal responsibility.

title: In Nantes, a 9,000 m² Office Building Program Takes Shape Thanks to a Volume Assembly
summary: A Nantes, a new real estate project spans 9,000 m², featuring three office buildings and a fourth to be defined. This project highlights an innovative legal structure, allowing each building to function independently, promoting greater flexibility. With a focus on 5% reuse, the project's completion is expected in 2028.

title: Seine-et-Marne: 'The Feeling of an Island' on the Marne River
summary: A landscape renovation project in Seine-et-Marne has transformed 1.3 km of riverbanks along the Marne, enhancing ecological resilience by replacing palplanches with vegetation-based solutions. The initiative aimed to involve local residents while improving biodiversity and access to natural spaces, culminating in the creation of a new 'fluvial park'. This project, costing €8.2 million, also features significant new plantings and recreational facilities.

title: Nanterre: The Old Ensa Returns to Service
summary: The former school of architecture in Nanterre is being revitalized as part of the Grand Paris project. Completed in May 2026, the campus, featuring modern structures alongside the old building, can accommodate 4,800 students. This significant renovation showcases a blend of heritage preservation and modern building standards.

title: Ukraine Recovery Conference 2026: recovery moves into delivery mode
summary: The Ukraine Recovery Conference (URC 2025) will take place in Rome on July 10-11, 2025, focusing on Ukraine's reconstruction and resilience. It emphasizes a collaborative approach among various stakeholders to support economic recovery and growth. Key themes will include business, human, local and regional dimensions, and enhanced security capabilities.

title: FIEC Calls for a Market-Driven Framework for Circular Construction
summary: FIEC emphasizes the need for a market-driven approach to circular construction at a recent policy panel in Brussels. The forthcoming Circular Economy Act aims to enhance Europe’s competitiveness while promoting the use of secondary materials in construction. FIEC advocates for coherent legislation that supports market incentives over mandatory quotas to drive demand for circular materials.

title: FIEC keeps public procurement reform high on the agenda
summary: FIEC supports the EU's public procurement reform, emphasizing the need for Directives to maintain flexibility within national systems. They argue that a shift to Regulations could complicate the framework, increasing legal uncertainty and administrative burdens. The construction sector relies heavily on public works contracts, making these reforms crucial for supporting investment and achieving climate objectives.

title: Dutch Delegation Visits FIEC in Brussels
summary: Bij extreme hitte is het cruciaal dat werkgevers verantwoordelijkheden nemen voor de gezondheid van hun medewerkers. De cao Bouw & Infra bevat richtlijnen en andere maatregelen voor veilig werken in zulke omstandigheden. Medewerkers moeten ook goed voor zichzelf zorgen om gezondheidsrisico's te vermijden.

title: Provisional agreement reached on the e-declaration for the posting of workers
summary: The Council and European Parliament have reached a provisional agreement on a digital declaration system for posted workers. This regulation aims to reduce the administrative burden on businesses and improve compliance monitoring for posted workers. By fully digitalizing posting declarations, the initiative supports the 'One Europe, One Market' roadmap.

title: 10 million people benefitting from up- and re-skilling activities since 2022
summary: The Pact for Skills Annual Report 2025 showcases significant progress in upskilling and reskilling efforts across Europe, with nearly 3.9 million individuals benefiting from training and investments surpassing €1 billion. It highlights the growth of partnerships and the commitment to meet evolving skills demands while facing challenges such as resource limitations. The report emphasizes the importance of lifelong learning and collaborative initiatives to enhance workforce skills and adaptability.

title: Parliament and Council agree on CMRD6
summary: The Council of the EU and the European Parliament have reached a provisional agreement to enhance worker protection against hazardous substances. This includes setting new occupational exposure limits and expanding regulations to improve workplace safety. The revisions aim to prevent thousands of illnesses and ensure legislation remains in line with scientific advancements.

title: The 4 Types of Construction Communication: Digitally Influenced Users Surpass Traditional Ones
summary: Die BauInfoConsult-Studie zeigt, dass sich das Informationsverhalten in der Baubranche verändert hat, wobei digitale Medien zunehmend an Bedeutung gewinnen. Trotz temporärer Vorlieben für persönliche Gespräche während der Pandemie überholen Online-Recherchen nun wieder die traditionellen Kommunikationskanäle. Insgesamt sind vier Typen von Baukommunikation identifizierbar, wobei digital geprägte Nutzer die Führung übernehmen.

title: Industry demands faster progress in building greening
summary: At the World Congress on Building Greening, experts called for faster measures to enhance climate resilience in cities. They highlighted the vast potential of greening rooftops and facades as a crucial step towards effective climate adaptation. The event emphasized collaboration among stakeholders to ensure that building greening becomes a standard practice.

title: BVES announces EU complaint against StromVKG
summary: Der BVES plant, eine EU-Beschwerde gegen das StromVKG einzureichen, da es europarechtliche Bedenken bezüglich Diskriminierung und Wettbewerbsverzerrung aufwirft. Der Verband betont, dass Versorgungssicherheit durch technologieoffenen Wettbewerb und nicht durch politische Vorgaben gewährleistet werden sollte. Zudem kritisiert er Beschränkungen bei Pooling-Lösungen und fordert eine faire Behandlung aller Technologien.

title: The smarter E Europe 2026: Fossil is yesterday
summary: The Smarter E Europe 2026 showcased how renewable energies can provide reliable and cost-effective energy supply. Over 2650 exhibitors proved that advanced technologies and solutions for energy transition are ready for implementation. The event emphasized the importance of flexibility and innovation in achieving a sustainable energy future.

title: Fagsi receives nationwide building approval for Proenergy modules
summary: Fagsi has received a nationwide building approval for its Proenergy modular construction method, marking a significant milestone for steel construction in Germany. The approval simplifies the permitting process by eliminating individual project approvals, thus ensuring compliance with fire protection and building regulations. The Proenergy system is designed for various uses such as offices, schools, and housing, offering energy-efficient solutions with reduced construction times.

title: Construction robots drill 16,000 holes in Frankfurt office building
summary: In Frankfurt, two Fischer Baubots are automating the drilling of 16,000 holes for a new office building, enhancing precision and safety. The construction aims to meet the demand for sustainable office spaces amidst rising vacancies. Completion of the project is scheduled for 2027.

title: Well advised on a future-proof heat supply
summary: The article discusses the evolution of Solites, a consulting firm specializing in solar thermal energy systems, marking its 20-year journey from research to comprehensive advisory services. Key figures, Dirk Mangold and Magdalena Berberich, highlight the increasing importance of systematic solutions for decarbonization amid growing complexities in heating networks. Furthermore, it emphasizes the necessity of integrating various renewable energy sources and storage solutions to achieve climate neutrality by 2045.

title: TWL-Technologie presents PVT collector for higher system temperatures
summary: TWL-Technologie introduces the Prisma PVT RBT collector, designed for higher system temperatures using back insulation. This new PVT collector utilizes a double glass solar module with a Rollbond heat exchanger, achieving summer temperatures of 60 to 65 degrees Celsius. Its installation system simplifies the integration of multiple collectors, with market launch scheduled for August.

title: Podcast: Transitioning into energy consulting
summary: In a recent podcast episode, Ranga Yogeshwar discusses the complexities of energy consultancy and its impact on the energy transition. He criticizes the unclear responsibilities among involved parties and the inadequacies of current funding programs. Yogeshwar emphasizes the need for innovation and better onboarding practices to enhance efficiency.

title: DEN elects new administrative board
summary: At the Deutsche Energieberater-Netzwerk (DEN) meeting on June 18, 2026, a new 19-member board was elected, focusing on enhancing regional networking and scientific collaboration. Chairwoman Jutta Maria Betz praised the network's expertise while introducing new members with diverse backgrounds. Additionally, the GRE department was emphasized for supporting political work and fostering research projects.

title: Pellet prices at summer low
summary: Die Preise für Holzpellets sind im Juni 2026 gesunken, was einen Kaufanreiz vor der Heizsaison bietet. Aktuell kostet eine Tonne Pellets durchschnittlich 376,77 Euro, was einen Vorteil von etwa 33 % gegenüber Heizöl und Erdgas ausmacht. Dies macht den Sommer zu einem idealen Zeitpunkt für den Kauf und gegebenenfalls für den Austausch alter Heizungen.

title: Award-winning multi-family solar house in Wernigerode
summary: Das Mehrfamilien-Sonnenhaus in Wernigerode wurde als erstes Neubauprojekt in Sachsen-Anhalt mit der Grünen Hausnummer Plus ausgezeichnet. Es nutzt ein umfassendes Energiekonzept mit Photovoltaik- und Solarthermieanlagen zur Energieversorgung. Mieter können den erzeugten Solarstrom kostenlos nutzen, was Nebenkosten um bis zu 50% senken kann.

title: Video shows PVT project for the industrial energy transition
summary: The automotive supplier Mahle is advancing decarbonization at its Vaihingen site using PVT technology. In 2025, it installed Germany's largest PVT system, generating electricity and heat simultaneously. This innovative setup, including seasonal geothermal energy storage, significantly reduces gas consumption for production.

title: 30 years of solar topics: Continuity in energy transition journalism
summary: The article commemorates the 30th anniversary of Solarthemen, an independent journal celebrating renewable energy journalism. Founded in 1996 by Guido Bröer and Andreas Witt, it has grown from a niche publication to a respected source on energy transition issues. Its 600th edition marks a milestone in sustainability reporting amidst evolving energy landscapes.

title: Split air conditioning units: Stiftung Warentest confirms profitability
summary: Die Stiftung Warentest hat Split-Klimageräte getestet und festgestellt, dass selbst ineffiziente Modelle im Heizbetrieb kostengünstiger sind als Gasheizungen, während sie gleichzeitig die Treibhausgasemissionen reduzieren. Die getesteten Geräte haben in den meisten Fällen die Note 'Gut' erhalten und bieten eine schnelle Temperaturregelung und Luftentfeuchtung. Diese Klimageräte werden als energieeffiziente Lösung empfohlen, insbesondere in Zeiten intensiver Hitze.

title: PVT collector drives heat pump
summary: Der eSMART PVT-Sole-Kollektor von Atec integriert sich in Wärmepumpenanlagen und erzeugt sowohl Strom als auch Wärme. Mit einem geräuschlosen Betrieb und effizienter Modulklimatisierung steigert er den elektrischen Ertrag. Zudem ermöglicht das modulare Design eine einfache Installation und Anpassung an bestehende Systeme.

title: EH55-Plus funding extended
summary: The EH55-Plus funding for energy-efficient buildings, supporting 100% renewable energy use, has been extended until the end of the year or until funds run out. Approximately 33,700 housing units are under construction, with around 343 million euros remaining in funding. The initiative aims to address construction challenges exacerbated by rising costs and geopolitical issues.

title: DGNB publishes sustainability certification for existing neighborhoods
summary: Die Deutsche Gesellschaft für Nachhaltiges Bauen hat einen neuen Kriterienkatalog für die Zertifizierung bestehender Quartiere veröffentlicht, der 15 Kriterien umfasst und an sieben Pilotprojekten getestet wurde. Das System soll Bestandshaltern und Kommunen helfen, Quartiere hinsichtlich Nachhaltigkeit und Klimaschutz zu bewerten. Es fokussiert Erhalt und Weiternutzung von Gebäuden und honoriert schrittweises Handeln sowie Teilerfolge.

title: Short study: Geothermal heating is the cheapest
summary: A short study by Prognos finds that ground-source heat pumps are more economical in the long term compared to gas heating systems, despite higher initial costs. Over a 20-year period, ground-source systems show around 8% lower annual costs than air-water heat pumps. The analysis highlights the importance of renewable local energy sources amid rising fossil fuel prices.

title: Germany's largest solar heating plant heats
summary: In Leipzig, Germany's largest solar thermal plant has officially started operations, equipped with approximately 13,000 solar collectors for district heating. This project aims to provide CO₂-free heat, marking a significant step toward the decarbonization of heating supply. It serves as a model for renewable energy integration into municipal heating networks.

title: Heat pumps heat almost three quarters of new residential buildings
summary: Im Jahr 2025 nutzen 73,6 Prozent der fertiggestellten Wohngebäude in Deutschland Wärmepumpen als Hauptheizung, was eine deutliche Steigerung gegenüber 2015 darstellt. Die Verwendung von erneuerbaren Energien im Neubau hat sich ebenfalls erhöht, mit 78,2 Prozent der Gebäude, die diese als Hauptenergiequelle nutzen. Erdgas verliert an Bedeutung, und in 87 Prozent der genehmigten Neubauten soll hauptsächlich erneuerbare Energie verwendet werden.

title: Bonded Windows with Approved System Solution
summary: The article discusses the challenges faced in window construction due to larger elements and increasing demands for stability and energy efficiency. A tested solution, glass edge bonding, permanently connects insulation glass with the frame, enhancing stability and design flexibility. Users are encouraged to consider certified products like OTTOCOLL® S 670 for reliable glass bonding.

title: Uniglas Group: Hero-Glas Becomes a Partner
summary: UNIGLAS has welcomed Hero-Glas as a new partner, enhancing its capabilities in insulating and specialty glass products. This collaboration strengthens their regional presence in Northwestern Germany while boosting innovation and technical precision. The partnership aims to deliver high-quality glass solutions tailored for modern architecture and industrial applications.

title: Time Savings in the Office with This Window & Door Configurator
summary: The STOLMA window and door configurator offers digital solutions to streamline project planning and administration in construction businesses, significantly reducing time spent on task completion. It enables easy configuration of components within 60 seconds, alongside transparent price comparisons and direct email offers. This tool, along with STOLMA's additional features, enhances efficiency and supports long-term success in the industry.

title: Stefan Gerling Now Responsible for Ventana Sales in Germany
summary: Stefan Gerling is appointed as the new Sales Director for Ventana Deutschland, aiming to enhance decision-making and customer proximity through a restructured sales organization. The changes include clearer responsibilities and shortened decision paths to foster efficiency and excellence. This restructuring coincides with the expansion of Ventana's production facility in Vreden, which has been a specialist in window custom construction since 1996.

title: Berlin Startup Cleans Facades with Drones
summary: The Berlin start-up skyXwash has unveiled a drone-based solution for facade cleaning, drastically reducing costs and labor risks. Utilizing advanced technology, the system promises to clean surfaces three times faster than traditional methods, while employing eco-friendly osmotic water. With plans for European expansion, the innovation aims to modernize the cleaning industry and create new job roles.

title: TS Aluminium Turns Metal Builders into Allies
summary: TS Aluminium transforms metal builders into allies through a successful marketing network called 'Sonne am Haus', enhancing collaboration and customer outreach. Members benefit from tailored services, including landing pages and a strong social media presence. The initiative emphasizes collective support to improve competitive positioning in the market.

title: Dorma-Glas Insolvent – Procedure in Self-Administration Opened
summary: Dorma-Glas GmbH has filed for insolvency with a self-administration procedure initiated by the Bielefeld District Court. Despite the insolvency, the company remains operational under the supervision of an insolvency administrator, aiming for stabilization and potential restructuring. Founded in 1978, Dorma-Glas specializes in fittings for glass doors and systems, but now faces challenges within the fluctuating construction market.

title: Gross Windows & Doors Combines Deceuninck Profiles with Perfect System
summary: Groß Fenster + Türen GmbH has started using the Perfect System by Stemeseder, integrating it with Deceuninck's Elegant Infinity 76 profiles. This innovative system allows for a seamless connection of multiple window components without the need for drilling. It dramatically reduces assembly times by up to 80%, enhancing both efficiency and product quality.

title: Window Nerd Holger Brings Veka the VFF Marketing Award
summary: Veka's 'Wenn, dann Veka!' campaign, led by brand ambassador Holger, won the VFF Marketing Award 2026 after achieving over 310 million impressions, showcasing a shift from technical to consumer-friendly marketing. The initiative highlighted the importance of digital engagement and included partner companies through a co-branding model. This award-winning campaign marks the beginning of Veka's long-term strategy to enhance brand awareness among consumers.

title: Meesenburg Showroom Explains Structural Connections
summary: The Meesenburg Group has opened a groundbreaking showroom in Kirchheim, Munich, showcasing over 20 tactile exhibits related to building connections. This facility aims to unite architects, builders, and craftsmen for better project planning and reduced changes during construction. With a focus on practicality, it serves as a hub for collaboration and education in the building sector.

title: Gugelfuss Takes Over, Steinbrück Calls for Change in the Industry
summary: At the 2026 VFF Congress in Göttingen, Anton Gugelfuss took over leadership amidst discussions on industry challenges and innovation. Keynote speaker Peer Steinbrück called for confidence restoration and concrete policies to tackle the building crisis. The event highlighted sustainable practices and potential growth opportunities in the sector.

title: ift Door and Gate Days Held for the First Time in Münster
summary: The ift Tür- und Tortage event in Münster explored current trends in technology, norming, and economics for the door and gate industry. Key topics included automation, cybersecurity, and climate resilience, emphasizing the need for sustainability and digitalization. The event marked its first occurrence in Münster, providing valuable networking opportunities for professionals.

title: Kuraray: Optimizing Laminated Glass with AI
summary: Kuraray has introduced the Genius Mode, an AI-based optimization tool for laminated glass configurations, which automates the design process. This tool allows glass processors to set parameters for sound insulation, structural strength, and carbon footprint, yielding the best configuration. By streamlining the planning phase, it offers significant time savings and enhances decision-making through data-driven insights.

title: Accursia Capital Sells Eckelt Glas GmbH
summary: Accursia Capital has completed the sale of Eckelt Glas GmbH, a manufacturer of architectural and insulating glass based in Steyr, Austria. The transaction aligns with Accursia's strategic portfolio management and allows for focused deployment of capital and resources. Eckelt's expertise in high-performance glazing solutions supports high-end facade projects, emphasizing the company's role in the premium construction sector.

title: Aldra Switches to Biocide-Free Wood Treatment
summary: Aldra has completely transitioned to a biocide-free wood treatment, utilizing Remmers' I-130 eco impregnation since June 2026. This shift enhances the recyclability of treated wood windows. Aldra's move supports sustainable practices and aligns with modern construction standards.

title: Sanco Annual General Meeting 2026
summary: At the 2026 Sanco AGM in Mallorca, Antonio Gioello highlighted the strength of the European partner network and announced the introduction of innovative 0.5mm thin triple-glass insulation. The group is also celebrating a positive growth trend with the addition of four new partners while emphasizing resilience in volatile markets. Keynote speaker Marc Wallert emphasized the importance of solidarity and resilience in challenging times.

title: Hegla-Hanic Innovation Days: AI and Digitalization for Glass Processors
summary: The Hegla-Hanic Innovation Days focused on Artificial Intelligence, digitalization, and automation for the glass industry. The event showcased glass365, a new ERP solution tailored to glass processors, enhancing real-time data access across devices. Emphasizing the importance of secure data processing, it highlighted how technology could improve communication and efficiency in production.

title: Ventana Restructures Management with Department Head
summary: Ventana Deutschland hat eine neue Führungsebene mit vier Bereichsleitern etabliert, um klare Verantwortlichkeiten und eine starke Führung zu gewährleisten. Diese Umstrukturierung soll das Unternehmen auf die nächste Wachstumsphase vorbereiten und Entscheidungen näher an operative Themen bringen. Die Veränderungen erfolgen parallel zur Erweiterung des Standorts in Vreden und sind Teil eines langfristigen Entwicklungsprozesses.

title: Vitrum is Being Reorganized
summary: Die Vitrum S.r.l. hat mit der Ernennung von Barbara Antonini zur Präsidentin einen neuen Verwaltungsrat für die Amtszeit 2026-2030 gewählt. Die neue Führungsstruktur zielt darauf ab, Vitrum als internationale Plattform für die Glaswirtschaft zu stärken und den Hohlglassektor besser einzubeziehen. Antoninis Erfahrung und Engagement versprechen eine Wachstumsphase und stärkere internationale Vernetzung der Glasindustrie.

title: Change at the Top of the Association: Anton Gugelfuß Takes Over Presidency
summary: Anton Gugelfuß succeeds Helmut Meeth as the new president of the Verband Fenster + Fassade (VFF), marking a significant leadership change. Under Gugelfuß's leadership, the VFF aims to navigate current challenges in the construction industry while focusing on political representation and digital transformation. The association is optimistic about growth despite market challenges, with initiatives to strengthen its structural foundations and enhance member services.

title: District Heating with River Water: iKWK Project by Carrier Klimatechnik
summary: The city of Wittenberge is implementing a sustainable heating solution using river water from the Stepenitz as an energy source. This system, called iKWK, employs a cascaded heat pump facility to provide heat for 200-300 households while minimizing CO2 emissions. The heat is generated through two submerged pumps that draw river water into a central heating facility.

title: Underfloor Heating in Summer: Surface Cooling with Heat Pump
summary: Die Verwendung einer Fußbodenheizung zur Kühlung im Sommer durch eine Wärmepumpe ist eine innovative und effektive Lösung, die ohne separate Klimaanlage auskommt. Diese Technik ermöglicht eine gleichmäßige Wärmeentziehung über große Bodenflächen bei moderaten Temperaturen. Staatliche Förderungen können die Kosten für die Installation erheblich reduzieren.

title: Heat Pump Electricity/Gas Price Barometer in June 2026
summary: The WP-Strom-/Gaspreis-Barometer for June 2026 provides a snapshot of the electricity and gas price ratios across twelve regions in Germany. It highlights regional differences in pricing for heating energy sources, influenced by network usage charges, and compares pricing situations for gas heating versus heat pumps. The article indicates minor fluctuations in energy prices, emphasizing effective pricing strategies for both energy sources.

title: Fracking Relieves German Gas Supply Only Limitedly
summary: Fracking in Deutschland hat nur begrenztes Potenzial zur Stärkung der Erdgasversorgung, kann Engpässe nicht schnell beheben und die Gaspreise kaum senken. Experten schätzen, dass Hunderte von Bohrungen notwendig wären, um signifikante Mengen zu fördern. Die Forschung empfiehlt Probebohrungen für belastbare Daten, obwohl dies auf gesellschaftlichen Widerstand stoßen könnte.

title: Heating with Renewables: Biomass Leads Heat Market
summary: Biomasse ist im Wärmesektor die wichtigste erneuerbare Energiequelle und hat im letzten Jahr 40 Millionen Tonnen CO2 vermieden. Holzversorgung, insbesondere durch Scheitholz, Hackschnitzel und Pellets, spielt eine entscheidende Rolle für die nachhaltige Wärmebereitstellung in privaten Haushalten. Der HKI betont, dass Holz moderne Heizsysteme sinnvoll ergänzen kann, um eine zuverlässige Wärmeversorgung sicherzustellen.

title: ModG: Heat Pump Association Warns of Cuts in Funding
summary: The Bundesverband Wärmepumpe warns that the proposed GModG bill may undermine heating market progress by lacking clear end dates for fossil fuels and specifications for hybrid solutions. Urgent improvements to ensure consumer-friendly terms and sustained heating subsidies are necessary to promote investments in heat pumps. The organization highlights the importance of maintaining support for heating technologies to ensure climate neutrality by 2045.

title: First German Hydrogen Network in Regular Operation: Vaillant Delivers H2 Heating Technology
summary: Das Projekt H2Dahoam hat in Hohenwart, Bayern, das erste deutsche Wasserstoffnetz in Betrieb genommen, das Haushalte und Gewerbe mit 100% Wasserstoff versorgt. Vaillant spielt eine Schlüsselrolle, indem es innovative Brennwertgeräte bereitstellt, die den Übergang zu Wasserstoffheiztechnik ermöglichen. Ab 2027 ist die lokale Wasserstoffproduktion geplant, um die Infrastruktur weiter auszubauen.

title: Hybrid Heating: Heat Pump, PV, and Water-Guided Fireplace Combined
summary: Die Hybrid-Heizung kombiniert Wärmepumpe, Photovoltaikanlage und einen wassergeführten Kaminofen, um Heizkosten zu minimieren und den Komfort zu maximieren. Durch optimierte Systemplanung und Energiemanagement wird die Effizienz deutlich gesteigert, insbesondere bei kalten Temperaturen. Diese innovative Lösung bietet ein behagliches Wohngefühl mit geringen Emissionen.

title: Heat Pumps: A Financing Problem, Not an Acceptance Problem
summary: The article discusses the financial challenges faced by homeowners in Germany when considering heat pump installations. Research reveals that the primary barriers are economic rather than technical, with many homeowners unable to invest due to income constraints. Initiatives are suggested to provide targeted financial support to encourage the transition to more environmentally friendly heating solutions.

title: How Circulating Pumps Work Efficiently
summary: Hocheffizienz-Umwälzpumpen sind entscheidend für die Effizienz und Betriebssicherheit von Heizungsanlagen und können bis zu 80% Energie sparen. Alte Pumpen verbrauchen unnötig viel Strom und verursachen hydraulische Probleme. Der Wechsel zu modernen Pumpen optimiert die Wärmeverteilung und reduziert die Betriebskosten.

title: Online Training for VDI 4645: Become an Expert for Heat Pump Systems
summary: Eine dreitägige Online-Schulung zur VDI 4645 für Wärmepumpensysteme findet vom 29. Juni bis 1. Juli 2026 statt. Nach der Schulung können Teilnehmer den Titel „Sachkundiger für Wärmepumpensysteme nach VDI 4645“ führen. Die Inhalte umfassen Planung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Wärmepumpen.

title: Kermi: Air/Water Heat Pump x-change dynamic pro XL and Cascade Collector
summary: Kermi has introduced the x-change dynamic pro XL heat pump, offering high heating performance with capacities of up to 30 kW, or 150 kW in a cascade system. The new cascade collector simplifies hydraulic connections, reducing installation complexity for large buildings. It features efficient operation with environmentally friendly refrigerant and comes with integrated safety components for effective performance.

title: Atec Reduces Heat Pump Noise with eSilent Prisma
summary: Atec's eSilent Prisma series effectively reduces noise from heat pumps by 12-20 dB(A), making it essential for sound protection in closely built environments. These covers are available in various designs and adapt to multiple installations while also offering protection against weather and theft. Additionally, they are compliant with regulations and eligible for funding under the Federal Program for Efficient Buildings.

title: Galletti: MLP Series Receives Two New Power Sizes
summary: Galletti has expanded its MLP series with two new models offering 26 and 30 kilowatts, growing the range from 6.4 to 30 kilowatts. These units utilize R290 refrigerant and feature inverter control for energy efficiency, making them suitable for construction and renovation. The compact design allows easy installation in tight spaces, supporting various heating systems.

title: BRÖTJE Complements the Installation of the BLW Mono.1
summary: BRÖTJE has introduced new installation sets for the BLW Mono.1 air-water heat pump, enhancing its placement flexibility. The sets include a montaging base and a design base, catering to various ground conditions. Additionally, a reusable transport aid is available to facilitate easy movement of the outdoor unit.

title: Watts Presents New Smart Thermostats
summary: Watts has launched two new smart thermostats to enhance room temperature control. The BT-SRT03-RF features precise sensors for accurate temperature measurement and can be integrated with smart home systems. The BT-ST03-RF allows programming for multiple rooms, enhancing energy management.

title: AEG: Small Instantaneous Water Heaters as Hot Water Solutions for Public and Commercial Buildings
summary: AEG's electronic on-demand water heaters provide a quick and economical solution for generating hot water in public and commercial buildings, available in power classes from 3.5 to 6.5 kW. Designed for hygiene and energy efficiency, they fit in limited spaces and require minimal installation effort, making them suitable for various sanitary applications. These heaters ensure precise temperature control, reducing water waste and lowering energy consumption.

title: ÖkoFEN: Pellet Condensing Boiler Pellematic Condens XL
summary: The ÖkoFEN Pellematic Condens XL is a highly efficient pellet boiler ranging from 100 to 130 kW, designed to reduce pellet consumption by up to 15%. Its compact dimensions facilitate easy replacement of existing heating systems, while the ZeroFlame technology minimizes emissions. With advanced automation features and flexible storage options, it ensures optimal performance and convenience.

title: Layered Storage from LINK3: Efficiency and Flexibility for Every Requirement
summary: LINK3 has introduced three new storage models: Comfortlink-Basic and -Plus cater to single-family homes and micro-networks, while Satellite-Plus is designed for large systems. The Comfortlink-Basic features 900 liters of storage and integrates well with heat pumps and biomass heating. The new models maintain high stratification efficiency with four decoupled zones, offering versatile application potential.

title: Alpha innotec Hybrox SE: Air/Water Heat Pump with R290
summary: Die Alpha innotec Hybrox SE ist eine neue Luft/Wasser-Wärmepumpe, die sich durch ein einfaches Bedienkonzept und ein starkes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis auszeichnet. Sie bietet bis zu 75 °C Vorlauf und nutzt das natürliche Kältemittel R290, was sie umweltfreundlich macht. Die Serie ist in vier Leistungsgrößen erhältlich und eignet sich sowohl für Neubauten als auch für Sanierungen.

title: PAW HomeBloC GT: Space-Saving Replacement for Gas Boilers
summary: Der PAW HomeBloC GT ist eine kompakte Wohnungsstation, die als platzsparender Ersatz für Gasthermen dient und für den Einsatz mit Wärmepumpen konzipiert ist. Sie ermöglicht eine hygienische Warmwasserbereitung und ist ideal für Sanierungsprojekte zur schnellen Umstellung auf erneuerbare Energien, ohne bauliche Maßnahmen. Die Station wird vormontiert geliefert und bietet langlebige Qualitätskomponenten sowie eine benutzerfreundliche Temperaturregelung.

title: Heating Water Treatment in Practice: 20 m³ Heating System Successfully Renovated
summary: The article discusses the successful renovation of a 20 m³ heating system, emphasizing the importance of professional heating water treatment to prevent sludge buildup and corrosion. A comprehensive cleaning and treatment process was employed to restore water quality, ensuring operational efficiency and extending system lifespan. It highlights the role of systematic maintenance for enhanced energy efficiency and reliability in heating systems.

title: Is the Gas Industry Downplaying Methane Emissions?
summary: The German gas industry is using a statistics tool that allegedly violates EU methane regulations by relying on outdated standard values instead of actual measurements. This could lead to significant underestimations of methane emissions and non-compliance with reporting obligations. The German Environmental Aid (DUH) urges authorities to demand the tool's legal compliance to protect environmental standards.

title: Sifer Promotion Launches the Renewal of Capelette, a Railway Wasteland Rebranded as Incity
summary: Sifer Promotion is revitalizing the Capelette area in Marseille, transforming a 2.3-hectare brownfield site into the mixed-use "Incity" project. This initiative will include 410 residential units, along with various amenities such as a student residence and commercial spaces, and aims for completion by 2029. Key sustainable features include water management systems and solar panels, enhancing the urban landscape.

title: Laura Sarreméjean, Co-Director of Sarreméjean Matériaux: 'Our Recent Acquisitions Influenced Alteral's Proposal'
summary: Laura Sarreméjean, co-manager of Sarreméjean Matériaux, discusses their decision to leave Tout Faire and join Alteral, emphasizing their commitment to local identity and customer focus. The company aims to enhance its market position through recent acquisitions and strategic initiatives. They anticipate a continued evolution of their product offerings while maintaining essential supplier relationships.

title: Cultural Heritage...Your Official Texts for Tuesday, July 21, 2026
summary: On July 21, 2026, the 'Moniteur' offers insights on the preservation of France's cultural heritage, emphasizing the importance of supporting religious architecture amidst declining religious practice. An instruction from the Ministry of Culture details public aid measures and urges local communities to enhance inventory efforts for heritage sites. The article highlights the collaboration required between the state, local authorities, and religious representatives for safeguarding this vital cultural asset.

title: Colas Gains Experience in Urban Site Electrification in Lyon Using Battery-Powered Equipment
summary: Colas is enhancing its experience with urban construction site electrification by using battery-powered machinery, including a 15-ton electric excavator, on a project in Lyon's Confluence district. This initiative aims to align construction with sustainable development goals by utilizing decarbonized concretes and electric site equipment. The successful implementation demonstrates the potential for electric machinery to contribute significantly to reducing carbon footprints in construction.

title: Housing Recovery in Europe (2/3): Italy Focuses on Rehabilitation to Strengthen its Social Offering
summary: L'Italie met en place le "Piano Casa" pour relancer la réhabilitation de logements sociaux, visant à créer 100 000 logements à loyer modéré d'ici 2036. Cependant, cette initiative soulève des inquiétudes concernant l'exclusion des petites entreprises et la hausse des coûts de construction. Le plan pourrait ne pas suffire à résoudre la crise du logement dans les métropoles italiennes.

title: The Hive Makes a Buzz with Wood
summary: La Ruche, inaugurée à Ebersheim, est un bâtiment innovant en bois, conçue pour favoriser les échanges humains au sein de ses quatre niveaux organisés en coursives. Le projet a mobilisé un investissement de 30 M€ et met en avant des matériaux biosourcés tels que des murs à ossature bois et un toit végétalisé. Cette structure de 6 790 m² sert de tiers-lieu pour le groupe Schmidt, fabricant de cuisines.

title: In Saône-et-Loire, the Last 9 km to Complete the Widening of the Centre-Europe Atlantic Road Will Be Completed
summary: Les travaux pour compléter l'élargissement de la Route Centre-Europe Atlantique en Saône-et-Loire vont commencer, réalisant les derniers 9 km nécessaires. Ce projet de 595 M€ transformera 73 km de routes en double voie. Après des débats sur le financement, l'État s'est engagé à couvrir le surcoût de 15 M€.

title: Houses Promising Zero Euro Electricity
summary: Le groupe britannique Octopus Energy inaugure à Bletterans en France des maisons « zéro euro » en électricité, permettant aux propriétaires de bénéficier de cette offre pendant cinq à dix ans, sous conditions. Cette initiative s'inscrit dans un projet d'écoquartier de 51 pavillons, équipés de technologies durables telles que des panneaux photovoltaïques. Octopus vise à construire 15 000 maisons similaires en France d'ici 2030.

title: Housing Recovery in Europe (1/3): Spain, Future Champion of Industrialized Social Production?
summary: L'Espagne, confrontée à une crise du logement, met en place un plan de relance de 7 milliards d'euros pour renforcer son offre sociale. Le gouvernement de Pedro Sanchez veut industrialiser la production de logements tout en évitant leur privatisation. Ce plan vise à construire 250 000 unités par an, mais le marché fait face à une pénurie de main-d'œuvre.

title: CAUE in Crisis (1/5): Facing a Major Financial Crisis, the CAUEs Seek a New Economic Model
summary: Les Conseils d'architecture, d'urbanisme et de l'environnement (CAUE) font face à une crise financière sans précédent, menaçant leur existence. Leur modèle économique doit être réinventé alors que les recettes continuent de diminuer drastiquement. Cette situation pose la question de la viabilité et de l'efficacité des structures d'ingénierie publique dans un contexte de contraintes budgétaires.

title: Biogas Production Certificate: Regulatory Framework to Be Extended Beyond 2028
summary: Le gouvernement prévoit de prolonger jusqu'en 2041 l'obligation de certificats de production de biogaz pour soutenir le biométhane. Cette décision vise à renforcer la visibilité pour les investisseurs et producteurs face à des cycles d'investissement à long terme. La publication du décret est attendue fin septembre 2026.

title: 'The CAUE of Manche is the First to Enter Liquidation, But All are Threatened,' Says Emmanuel Fauchet
summary: Emmanuel Fauchet, director of CAUE 50, discusses the reasons behind the judicial liquidation of the Manche's CAUE, highlighting financial difficulties faced by all CAUEs in France due to a change in tax collection laws. The CAUE's budget drastically decreased, leading to the liquidation despite efforts to maintain operations with dwindling resources. Fauchet emphasizes the need for a reevaluation of funding models to preserve these essential advisory bodies in urban planning.

title: Near Nancy, the SME Chassériaux Solarizes the Museum-Aquarium, a Historical Art Deco Building
summary: La PME Chassériaux a intégré des panneaux photovoltaïques au Muséum-aquarium de Nancy, un bâtiment Art déco classé. Ce projet, en collaboration avec Elec 3 et Etnair, a coûté plus de 200 000 euros HT et permettra de produire 42 MWh par an, couvrant 5% des besoins énergétiques du muséum. Le système est loué pour son excellente étanchéité, garantissant la conservation des collections du muséum.

title: Caséo Convention 2026 in Porto: Focus on Development
summary: The annual Caséo convention took place in Porto, Portugal from June 11 to 14, 2026, bringing together network members for work meetings and social activities. Caséo reported positive annual results, with ongoing territorial expansion and six new store openings. The organization emphasizes strengthening ties among members through training programs, enhancing operational tools, and focusing on underrepresented territories.

title: At the International Wood Trade Fair in Nantes, the Sector Smiles Contrary to the Construction Market
summary: Le Carrefour International du Bois 2026, qui s'est tenu à Nantes, a révélé une filière bois en pleine forme, contrastant avec un marché de la construction plus difficile. Des distributeurs diversifiés ont participé, cherchant à explorer de nouveaux partenariats et opportunités de sourcing. Malgré les incertitudes économiques, le secteur reste dynamique avec une légère hausse des volumes de bois de construction.

title: National Low-Carbon Strategy...Your Official Texts for Monday, July 20, 2026
summary: This article outlines France's revised national low-carbon strategy, which sets emissions objectives for the years 2024-2038 to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050. It also covers updates on the national register for co-ownership associations regarding data management. Additionally, it highlights recent appointments within the Ministry of Public Action and Accounts.

title: Food Trade Mutations Offer Opportunities to Landlords, Developers, and Construction Companies
summary: Le secteur du commerce alimentaire subit d'importantes mutations, favorisant les formats de proximité au détriment des hypermarchés. Cela crée des opportunités pour les foncières et les promoteurs d'immeubles, notamment pour des projets de développement urbain et de transformation de sites existants. Malgré les tensions politiques locales qui freinent l'avancement de certains projets, le marché immobilier alimentaire continue d'évoluer.

title: Summer Comfort: 70% of Homes in France Could Become Habitable Thanks to Passive Solutions
summary: In France, 70% of residential buildings can be made habitable during heatwaves through passive solutions like solar protection and nighttime ventilation. The collective Nos Villes à 50 degrés emphasizes adapting buildings to climate change, showcasing scientific approaches based on extensive data analysis. With pilot projects underway, simple interventions are being tested to improve summer comfort in homes.

title: A Responsible Local Data Center
summary: La communauté d’agglomération Pau Béarn Pyrénées et Axione lanceront le premier data center public des Pyrénées-Atlantiques en octobre 2027. Ce data center de 450 m² sera conçu pour une utilisation responsable de l'énergie via un système de free cooling et une consommation d'eau limitée. Il visera à fournir des services d’hébergement de données aux administrations et partenaires économiques locaux.

title: In Genouillé, the Wind Farm Reaps Benefits
summary: Le parc éolien de Genouillé, mis en service en août 2026, bénéficie directement aux 800 habitants grâce à une remise sur une offre d'électricité verte. Le projet, géré par Sorégies, prévoit également des retombées fiscales significatives pour la commune et la communauté de communes. Cette initiative souligne l'engagement vers des énergies renouvelables et le soutien communautaire.

title: Geothermal Energy: The Potential of the Subsoil of Île-de-France Revealed
summary: The article discusses the increasing attractiveness of deep geothermal energy as an alternative to rising hydrocarbon prices. This source of energy can heat urban areas by accessing heat from underground waters at depths exceeding 500 meters. The French government has been strongly supporting this initiative, especially since 2023.

title: The Center of Expertise for Heat Pumps Officially Launched
summary: The Centre d'expertise pour les pompes à chaleur (Cepac) was launched on May 20, 2026, aimed at providing reliable information on technical and legislative developments related to heat pumps. This initiative, presented during the Pac day organized by the French association for heat pumps (Afpac), is set to benefit construction professionals. It consolidates support for the evolving market of renewable energy solutions.

title: In Rennes, Urban Restructuring of the Hôtel Dieu District Continues
summary: The restructuring of the Hôtel Dieu site in Rennes involves the rehabilitation of the former hospital and the construction of 415 new housing units. This large-scale urban renovation project is part of the Rennes 2030 initiative aimed at revitalizing the city center and expanding into surrounding areas. The program, which began in January 2021, is set to be completed by 2028.

title: Industrial Hoffmann Green Signs Partnership with Norée Construction
summary: Hoffmann Green, a cement manufacturer, has announced a partnership with Norée Construction. This collaboration aims to innovate and enhance sustainable construction practices. The partnership highlights significant developments within the industry.

title: Energy Saving Certificates (CEE), a Strategic Lever for French Energy Sovereignty
summary: Les Certificats d'Économies d'Énergie (CEE) soutiennent l'efficacité énergétique en France, allégeant les factures des ménages et entreprises tout en promouvant l'électrification des usages. Malgré des critiques, leur financement contribue à réduire les dépenses énergétiques et améliorer la souveraineté industrielle. En fin de compte, les CEE demeurent cruciaux pour réduire la dépendance aux énergies fossiles et bâtir un avenir durable.

title: C'est dans l'actu: The Next Transformation of the Louvre Museum
summary: The Louvre Museum is set for a major transformation, announced by Culture Minister Catherine Pégard, as part of the "Louvre Nouvelle Renaissance" project. The project aims to enhance visitor experience with new entrances and facilities, including a dedicated room for the Mona Lisa. The architectural firms involved include Studios Architecture Paris, Selldorf Architects, and Base Landscape Architecture.

title: Eiffage Strengthens Its Position in the Data Center Market
summary: Eiffage's German subsidiary, Salvia, is expanding its operations in the data center market through a recent acquisition. This move is part of Eiffage's strategy to strengthen its position in energy systems across Europe. The expansion reflects the growing demand for data centers amid increasing digitalization.

title: Sonepar France Welcomes a New Director of Offer
summary: François Courtet has been appointed the new director of Sonepar France's offerings. His role will focus on enhancing the company's product strategy. This transition is a significant move for Sonepar as it aims to strengthen its market presence.

title: This Week's Figures: High Costs for New Housing by 2050
summary: The construction sector continues to face challenges, with significant news emerging over the past week despite the May Day holiday. Key topics include future residential needs by 2050, renovations of the Louvre, and financial trends affecting artisans in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region.

title: At Pessac (33), a Tertiary Building Aims for Well-Being and Environmental Sobriety
summary: À Pessac, un nouvel immeuble tertiaire nommé Inspiratio vise à allier confort des utilisateurs et respect de l'environnement. Ce bâtiment reflète les attentes modernes des entreprises en matière de flexibilité et de performance écologique. Le projet s'inscrit dans une tendance architecturale actuelle qui promeut des espaces de travail durables.

title: The Best Construction Site of France 2026: Two Exceptional Projects Awarded
summary: The 2026 edition of the Best Construction Site competition showcased fourteen exceptional projects to students from ESTP. This initiative, organized by the student association Passion BTP, emphasizes practical learning and engagement in diverse construction fields. Students explored various sites including the Grand Paris express and a new art museum in Massy.

title: Successfully Implementing an Energy Renovation Project
summary: Bail Rénov’ assists property managers, landlords, and tenants in understanding energy renovation and consumption through free services. Advisors provide guidance via remote support and in-person workshops to simplify renovation processes. Their goal is to improve housing performance, sustainability, and comfort for all.

title: In Fos-sur-Mer, the Photovoltaic Panel Gigafactory Will Not Be Built
summary: The planned photovoltaic gigafactory in Fos-sur-Mer, announced by Carbon to strengthen the PV industry, will not be realized. The project, previously slated for development, has been scrapped, canceling plans for 290,000 square meters of infrastructure. This decision reflects ongoing challenges in the implementation of large-scale renewable energy projects.

title: These Ecological Cabins Designed by Students Enchant Schoolyards
summary: L'exposition "Mini Maousse 10 : Super Cabane !" présente des conceptions écologiques de cabanes créées par des étudiants pour repenser l'habitat et favoriser les liens intergénérationnels. Initié par la Cité de l'architecture, le concours encourage l'utilisation de matériaux naturels et recyclés. Cette initiative vise à sensibiliser les enfants à l'écologie à travers un processus ludique.

title: Passoires thermiques and the Rental Market: "We Must Remove Barriers to Work"
summary: Valérie Létard discussed her housing mobilization law proposal in the French National Assembly on May 20, 2026, emphasizing the importance of easing barriers to existing housing solutions. She warned that without developments in unfurnished rentals through the Jeanbrun device, furnished rentals under the LMNP regime would gain traction. The proposal aims to address the ongoing housing crisis.

title: IA: Knowing One's Territory and Target Addresses to Find Upcoming RGE Projects
summary: The article discusses the importance of localized prospecting in the energy renovation sector, highlighting the need for businesses to adopt more respectful and targeted approaches, especially with the decline of unsolicited telemarketing. It emphasizes the role of artificial intelligence in enhancing data-driven targeting, allowing companies to identify the most relevant properties for their services. Ultimately, it advocates for a structured prospecting strategy to improve credibility and effectiveness in customer relations.

title: The Sustainable Building Plan Focuses on a Collective Narrative to Revitalize Renovation
summary: The current climate for building renovation is challenging, with a gradual withdrawal of public aid and relaxed restrictions on the rental of thermal sieves. Prioritization of new construction in housing plans hampers renovation efforts. There's an ongoing need for strategic changes in public renovation policies.

title: Towards a New Decrease in the Primary Energy Coefficient of Electricity?
summary: The article highlights a minor but significant detail in the national electrification plan that may reignite heated discussions come 2025. It suggests that changes to the primary energy coefficient of electricity are anticipated. This change reflects ongoing debates and possible implications for the sector.

title: Dispart Expands Its Expertise in Sanitary Spare Parts
summary: Dispart, a specialized network of Cedeo, is expanding its expertise in spare parts for sanitary heating and climate control systems. The article discusses their initiatives aimed at enhancing service offerings and product availability in this sector. It highlights the importance of this expansion for maintaining competitive edge and meeting market demands.

title: Grand Paris Nord University Hospital: Construction Starts
summary: The construction works for the Grand Paris Nord university campus have officially begun. This project aims to enhance healthcare access in the region, providing a modern infrastructure for hospital and educational services. It represents a significant investment in the future of healthcare in Paris.

title: The Construction Industry Strays Further from the Paris Agreements
summary: A recent report by the UN Environment Programme indicates that the construction sector is moving further away from the Paris Agreement goals for building decarbonization. The findings highlight a significant gap in the industry's progress towards sustainable practices. Urgent actions are required to align the sector with international climate commitments.

title: Gedibois Reaches 60 Points of Sale
summary: Gedibois, launched in 2008 by Gedicoop, continues its expansion across France. It has achieved significant success by reaching 60 points of sale, enhancing its territorial network. The initiative underscores the growing demand for construction and DIY materials in the market.

title: At 22, Activist Amine Kessaci Takes the Lead of Marseille Habitat
summary: Amine Kessaci has been elected as the president of Marseille Habitat on May 19, 2026. His candidacy was proposed by Marseille's mayor, Benoît Payan, and received unanimous support from the board. Kessaci's election marks a significant milestone in his 22-year activism career.

title: Real Estate: Reservations for New Housing Are Not Picking Up in the First Quarter
summary: In the first quarter of 2026, 16,502 new homes were reserved by individuals, reflecting a slight increase of 4% from the previous quarter. Compared to the same period in 2025, the increase is modest at just 0.5%. These figures were published by the Ministry of Urban Affairs and Housing on May 19, 2026.

title: In Toulouse, the Renewal of a Bank's Headquarters Goes Through Circular Architecture
summary: The Caisse d'Épargne Midi-Pyrénées is building a new campus in Toulouse, starting in September 2025 and expected to be completed by the start of the 2027 school year. This project will enhance its existing 7-hectare location in the Lardenne neighborhood, employing 1,900 people in the region. The initiative reflects a commitment to architectural innovation and community development.

title: A Note from the Sustainable Building Plan Invites Making Renovation More Desirable
summary: The Plan bâtiment durable has released a note presenting solutions to expedite the decarbonization of buildings. Authors Alexandra Lebert and Christophe Rodriguez emphasize that relying solely on rational discourse and scientific advantages may have limitations. They call for a broader discussion on the subject.

title: The Jeanbrun Device: "Disappointing in Two Ways"
summary: The article discusses the impact of the PTZ (zero-interest loan) in promoting housing projects that might not materialize without it. It highlights the current restrictions on new individual homes under the Jeanbrun device, which contrasts with previous ambitions outlined in the Cosson report. The need for such financial tools for social and economic inclusion is emphasized.

title: One of the Largest Technicenters in Europe Ready to Enter a New Era
summary: Le projet Villeneuve Demain vise à moderniser le technicentre de Villeneuve-Saint-Georges, l'un des plus grands d'Europe. S'étendant sur 30 hectares, il servira à maintenir et accueillir 125 trains, augmentant ainsi les capacités d'entretien. Ce développement est essentiel pour le RER D et la ligne R du Transilien au sud-est de Paris.

title: In Oise, a Microtunneler Named to Complete a Heat Network
summary: On May 18, 2026, local officials and representatives from the Oise mixed syndicate gathered in Villers-Saint-Paul to inaugurate a microtunneler. This infrastructure project aims to enhance the local network. The event highlights the commitment to improving regional development.

title: A New President for Inoha
summary: David Riquier has been appointed as the new president of Inoha, an association representing manufacturers of maintenance and DIY products. His leadership is expected to influence the industry positively. The announcement signals a new chapter for Inoha amidst evolving market demands.

title: Housing Crisis: From Cotentin to Maurienne, these full-employment territories face industrial rebound challenges
summary: L'article aborde l'adéquation entre réindustrialisation et offre de logements dans des territoires de plein emploi, tels que le Cotentin et la Maurienne. Une étude révèle les défis liés à la disponibilité de logements abordables pour les nouveaux travailleurs. Les acteurs locaux doivent anticiper et réagir face aux fluctuations du marché résidentiel induites par le rebond industriel.

title: In Marseille, a floor collapses in a building undergoing renovation
summary: A Marseille, a floor collapsed in a building undergoing rehabilitation in the Noailles district, prompting the establishment of a security perimeter. The building, which was not occupied, caused dust exposure affecting several people. The incident draws attention to the risks associated with aging residential infrastructure.

title: Gendarmerie's real estate: a new rental framework with purchase options reflecting actual financing costs is in the works
summary: The Ministry of the Interior is developing a new housing framework for gendarmerie barracks, aiming to replace the current rent cap. This initiative includes an option to purchase, addressing market value and actual financing costs. Enhanced investment is projected, with an objective of reaching €400 million by 2027.

title: In Versailles, the Grand Stables of the Sun King regain their volumes to host the future Campus of Crafts
summary: The Grandes Ecuries in Versailles are undergoing significant renovations to transform into a new Campus for arts and crafts, with 3,000 m² added for educational and production spaces. The project aims to restore historic volumes and integrate modern functionalities while preserving architectural integrity. Completion is expected by the end of Q1 2027, with a total investment of 14 million euros.

title: In Rennes, the Hotel-Dieu enters the final phase of its transformation
summary: Linkcity has begun the construction of 161 housing units at Hôtel-Dieu in Rennes, completing a ten-year transformation of the former hospital. Designed by ANMA, the residential program aims for completion by 2028, integrating mixed-use developments including hospitality and childcare. The project prioritizes augmented living spaces for families and incorporates a substantial green area.

title: Your official texts from Friday, June 19, 2026
summary: On June 19, 2026, 'Le Moniteur' published a selection of official texts pertinent to the construction and urban planning sectors, highlighting key regulatory updates. Notable appointments include Claudie Calabrin's departure from the Prime Minister's office and Estelle Sandre-Chardonnal's renewed role in the Pays de la Loire region. The daily offering underscores ongoing developments in public and private command as well as technical regulations.

title: Heatwave: at the James-Baldwin library in the 19th arrondissement of Paris, summer comfort is well on the agenda
summary: La médiathèque James-Baldwin à Paris, conçue avec des ambitions bioclimatiques, offre un confort estival sans climatisation par une utilisation efficace de la ventilation naturelle. Les usagers rapportent une expérience de fraîcheur agréable, même lors de vagues de chaleur, grâce à des mesures adaptatives intégrées dans sa conception.
